dedupe_keys.name: acn data adaptive charging network workplace ev charging sessions caltech jpl office 1

description: ACN-Data is an open dataset of electric vehicle charging sessions from Adaptive Charging Networks operated by PowerFlex Systems, published by the Caltech Adaptive Charging Network group to help researchers access real charging data. Each entry describes a single charging session, and the site lists three ways to access it: a web interface that downloads JSON files, a REST API and a Python API client, with separate tabs for fields and sites (the sites offered include Caltech, JPL and Office 1). The 2019 paper describes the dataset as dynamic workplace EV charging data with over 30,000 sessions and more added daily, analyses user behaviour, and demonstrates three uses: learning and predicting user behaviour with Gaussian mixture models, optimal sizing of on-site solar for adaptive charging, and using workplace charging to smooth the net demand duck curve. Coverage is a few sites in California. Access: free with registration for an API token; no licence is stated. Caveats: the page warns that web-interface downloads before 10 October 2019 had a timezone offset of 7 to 8 hours. It suits charging demand modelling and smart-charging research, and no directly related records are catalogued yet.
